title: SentinelReconfigurationStatusMessage
description: Schema for MEDIATE Message M11. This message is published by a Sentinel after reconfiguration execution to report the deployment status, state transition, and related Sentinel/Overwatch context. It is consumed by the Service Manager and Orchestrator through the Overwatch Broker.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be sentinelReconfigurationStatus.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the Sentinel reconfiguration status message was generated.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the message.

relatedSentinel.description: Relationship. Sentinel entity that reports the reconfiguration status.

relatedOverwatch.description: Relationship. Overwatch entity associated with the reporting Sentinel.

deployment.description: Property. Structured deployment information associated with the applied reconfiguration.

configurationId.description: List of configuration identifiers applied during the reconfiguration.

version.description: Version of the applied deployment configuration.

priority.description: Execution priority of the deployment. Values: regular, urgent.

bitstream.description: Binary payload metadata associated with the deployment.

fileName.description: Name of the bitstream binary file.

checksum.description: Integrity checksum of the bitstream binary file.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the bitstream binary file in bytes.

status.description: Property. Structured execution status of the Sentinel reconfiguration.

state.description: Current execution state of the reconfiguration.

details.description: Additional human-readable details about the reconfiguration result.

previousState.description: Property. Sentinel health state before the reconfiguration.

currentState.description: Property. Sentinel health state after the reconfiguration.

relatedSentinelReconfigurationCommand.description: Relationship. Reference to the triggering M10 SentinelReconfigurationCommand entity id.
